description: Works to Horse Chestnut tree covered by LBE ORDER NO 93 (1979): T1 - Crown reduction up to 4 metres and back to the most recent points of reduction.
decision_conditions: This consent is valid for two years.Reason: In order that the nature of work pertaining to this consent remains appropriate.

The works hereby approved shall not exceed the most recent previous points and every effort must be made to ensure that some leaf bearing structure remains within the crown and at the crown periphery. The works shall only be carried out strictly in accordance with British Standard 3998 [2010] 'Tree Works'.Reason: In the interests of the health, safety and appearance of the preserved tree.

Tree work should not be carried out during periods that are likely to interfere with or disturb breeding birds or mammals.Reason: In order to comply with the requirements of the Wildlife and Countryside Act (1981) and Conservation of Habitats and Species Regulations (2010).
